description: 石門水庫(含榮華壩)集水區範圍圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 石門水庫（含榮華壩）集水區範圍位於桃園市境淡水河最大支流大漢溪上，行政區跨新北市、桃園市、宜蘭縣、新竹縣、苗栗縣等五個縣市。 經濟部水利署北區水資源局於民國101年10月17日依據經濟部函頒「水庫集水區圖資製作與查認作業要點」第六條規定，提送石門水庫（含榮華壩）水庫集水區範圍。 本水庫集水區範圍係以水庫大壩以上全流域稜線以內所涵蓋之區域為... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
